mapper.select: SELECT sc.student_id, sc.course_id, sc.mark, s.student_name, c.course_name, t.teacher_name FROM selectedcourse sc LEFT JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE sc.student_id = #{username} AND sc.mark IS NULL
